description:
Run JavaScript in a sandbox against the documentation at https://redocly.com. The script calls the sandbox functions on the global `site` object.
The only extra global is `site` - there is no `fetch`, `console`, `setTimeout`, `require`, or Node.js API; all I/O goes through `site`.

Workflow - minimize round-trips; one `discover` call plus one `execute` call covers most requests:
1. Analyze the request and decide which sandbox functions it needs.
2. Call `discover` with those names to get their exact TypeScript signatures - inputs, result shapes, and a worked example. NEVER call `execute` with guessed function names, parameter names, enum values, or result field names: read fields off the declared return types, not from assumptions.
3. Batch everything into a SINGLE script: chain function calls, pass one call's output into the next, process results in plain JavaScript, and `return` only what the request needs.

Functions for `execute` scripts (signatures come from `discover`):
- listApis — List the available APIs.
- getEndpoints — Get all endpoints for an API.
- getEndpointInfo — Get the details of an endpoint.
- getSecuritySchemes — Get the security schemes for an API.
- getFullApiDescription — Get the complete OpenAPI description.
- search — Search the documentation.
- listPages — List the docs navigation, one level per call.
- getPage — Read a docs page as Markdown, in line windows.
- grepPages — Find the docs lines that contain a text.

code.description: JavaScript to run in the sandbox. Return a value to receive it as the result.

description.description: A short, human-readable summary of what this code does.

name: execute

error.description: Why the code failed. Set only on a failed call

result.description: The value the code returned, as JSON

sentFetches.description: Every `fetch` request that reached an API before the failure, with its status; running the code again sends them again. Set only on a failed call

title: Query the docs with code
